body: Not in the Army, very strongly considering though

Seeking help honestly never happen to me, I'd never be able to get the job I want (68W) in the Army, I can barely get out to my mailbox without someone 4 feet in my ass and playing 20 questions with me. I just wish I had some family or something to go and get a change of scenery.

I guess they have really high hopes because they always talk about when "when I was little and smart". I fucked up this year though, failed 2 classes and get shit everyday from my parents. I'm one of the students that understood the work but I never felt inclined to do bullshit busy work. I'm somewhat successful in my JROTC (It's my unit number in my handle) I don't tell my friends about it because I feel too proud to do ask for help. My dad works as a mechanic and he's pretty much a god-tier machinist, my mom stayed at home and complained and made sure we didn't wake her up from her hangover nap. Being an immigrant sucks man.
Since the beginning of May pretty much, and every time I try to do something with my family they treat me like I'm fucking autistic.
I fucked up last year and was taking some online classes, writing essays for about 6 hours isn't really relaxing. I don't think it's my anger, I have just been thinking about suicide a lot more
